title: Orbital Strike Cannon
description: This datapack/mod/plugin adds an Orbital Strike Cannon like wemmbu!
body:
![ORBITAL STRIKE CANNON](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2555e3bd6a50ae26228a70143af76154f0da5f93.png)

Orbital Strike Cannon is a **Minecraft datapack** that adds devastating fishing rod weapons — cast your rod and rain down TNT from the sky!

---

## 🔥 Features

- **3 weapon families** — NUKE , STAB , CINEMATIC NUKE
- **3 power levels** per weapon (P1, P2, P3)
- **Aim variants** — add redstone to your recipe for precision targeting
- **Infinite-use variants** — never run out of STAB charges
- **Craftable** — shaped recipes in the crafting table, fully togglable

---

## 🎮 How to Use

### Crafting

All rods are crafted in the **crafting table**.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8e96ed2d929239e5fa35aabd720c00d9add67259.png)
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/043a82f99e2f4eacf876ea9323c136debf9e6f68.png)

Crafting can be toggled:
- `/function orbital:settings/craft_disable` — disable crafting
- `/function orbital:settings/craft_enable` — enable crafting

### Give Commands

| Command | Effect |
|---------|--------|
| `/function orbital:give/nuke_1` | NUKE Power 1 |
| `/function orbital:give/nuke_2` | NUKE Power 2 |
| `/function orbital:give/nuke_3` | NUKE Power 3 |
| `/function orbital:give/nuke_1_aim` | NUKE Power 1 AIM |
| `/function orbital:give/nuke_2_aim` | NUKE Power 2 AIM |
| `/function orbital:give/nuke_3_aim` | NUKE Power 3 AIM |
| `/function orbital:give/stab_1` | STAB Power 1 |
| `/function orbital:give/stab_2` | STAB Power 2 |
| `/function orbital:give/stab_3` | STAB Power 3 |
| `/function orbital:give/stab_aim_1` | STAB Power 1 AIM |
| `/function orbital:give/stab_aim_2` | STAB Power 1 AIM |
| `/function orbital:give/stab_aim_3` | STAB Power 1 AIM |
| `/function orbital:give/stab_aim_1_inf` | STAB Power 1 Infinite AIM |
| `/function orbital:give/stab_aim_2_inf` | STAB Power 2 Infinite AIM |
| `/function orbital:give/stab_aim_3_inf` | STAB Power 3 Infinite AIM |
| `/function orbital:give/cinematic_nuke` | Cinematic NUKE |
| `/function orbital:give/cinematic_nuke_aim` | Cinematic NUKE Aimed |

### Settings

| Command | Effect |
|---------|--------|
| `/function orbital:settings/message_disable` | Disable welcome message |
| `/function orbital:settings/message_enable` | Enable welcome message |
